name: Cooke triplet 50 mm f/5
source: Cooke triplet (N-SK16 / F2 / N-SK16) after the commonly tabulated 'Cooke 40 degree field' sample data (Zemax sample file; reconstructed, not verified against the primary source; the unscaled data has EFL ~45.8 mm, so a uniform scale of ~1.091 is applied here): radii/thicknesses 22.01359/-435.76044/-22.21328/20.29192/STOP/79.6836/-18.39533. Uniformly scaled to EFL 50 mm, stop set to f/5, sensor at the paraxial focus; semi-apertures chosen here. About 40 degrees full field.
